programmes.d: Charles wants Dan to find him a 1967 Corvette with a set-up that’s rare as hen’s teeth. Bob’s 1973 Cuda has been stored for most of its life – but even in storage time takes a heavy toll.
FantomWorks dull the fangs on a 1965 Shelby Cobra kit car and bring a 1964 Dodge Dart back on target.

Patsy and Apryle bring their 1968 Corvette in for mechanical work, but what their car really needs is a new paint job. Jim’s 1958 Impala is an auction car. It looks pretty but when it’s time to drive – it’s half the car Jim was hoping for.
Chris wants the 1950 F1 Truck he remembers from high school and Dean wants the 1968 Lincoln Continental he drove with his dad.

Bob spent years working on his beloved 1969 K20 Truck, but he needs FantomWorks to solve the mysteries within. Dan’s brother-in-law John shows up with a 1962 Ferrari kit car that looks hot, but the wiring could burn it to the ground.

Kim and Doug want to drive her father’s hyper-rare 1959 Thunderbolt, but the car was only set up for the racetrack. Batalla is a legendary motorcycle builder who asks Dan to restore his prized possession - a 1947 Knucklehead.

Larry wants to drive his1959 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun. Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather’s 1960 Bel Air only to find that he’s missing more critical components than he’s found…
Danny is so proud of the van he restored as a gift for his bandmate John Zito, that he decides to give his own classic van a make-over.
A Casino VIP visits Count's Kustoms to commission a hi-end chopper build for a huge blackjack bonus prize.
Count's Kustoms has had its most successful year to date.
Danny is doubly-blessed when a His and Hers restoration--a 1970 Plymouth Road Runner and a 1970 Dodge Coronet--are commissioned, but has The Count bitten off more than he can chew?
On this hour-long episode Danny is hosting a huge car show and needs to restore a '73 boat-tail Riviera to be the main attraction.
Inspired by the Rat Rods at a local shop, Danny sends the guys out to find parts for a Count's Kustoms Rat Rod.
Music industry royalty, Del Bryant has a Blazer he wants to pay tribute to his Tennessee roots.
Danny gets a call from Kevin's brother who wants to sell Danny a 1969 Cadillac, but they can't let Kevin know or else he'll never trust his brother or Danny again.
Kevin and the team come together to make something special for Danny. Meanwhile Danny runs into an old pal and his 1959 Corvette gasser.
Danny checks out a mind-blowing collection, which includes a 1933 Ford Roadster and a '53 Henry J. Meanwhile Kevin, Ryan and Mike make.
A returning customer needs Danny's help restoring a 1971 Road Runner to give as a commemorative gift to his wife and step-daughter.
Ryan works on a secret project for chopper shop Bones Legacy, while a Chevy Impala that redefines "lowrider" blinds Mike and Roli.
Harry Metcalfe revisits his classic Lotus Elan Sprint.
Koenigsegg reveals a 1500-bhp hypercar with no gearbox.
Testing 2012's hottest cars to crown the ultimate winner.

The Ferrari 458 Speciale is pushed to its limits on track at Anglesey.
Ken Block discusses Gymkhana, rallying and his passion for cars.
The Lamborghini LP580-2 keeps the rare NA RWD supercar alive.
Experience the Tokyo Motor Show's highlights including Mazda, Nissan and BMW concepts.

Clio 200 vs. Corsa VXR in a hot hatch track showdown.

Explore Abarth's lineup with rally legend Miki Biasion.

Embark on a road trip across Europe to uncover the soul of this 912-bhp Audi.
Test the Ford GT, Porsche 911 GT2 RS, AMG GT R and Lotus Exige Cup 430 at the Anglesey Coastal Circuit.
Is this generation of the Porsche 911 GT3 RS the ultimate track and road car? Then, test the McLaren 765LT.
Join Adam Towler in adrenaline-pumping trips inside Subaru rally cars.
Put the last combustion-powered Lotus through its paces. Then, find out if the Ferrari 296 GTB thrills.

How does this fabulous M3 fare with power to all four wheels? Then, can this Lamborghini beat the McLaren P1?
